parrafo_1.es: Sol y Mar Paellas & Catering monta la paellera, cocina en vivo y arma la mesa de catering completa: entradas, tabla de quesos y postre, para que tu evento se vea y sepa a algo preparado por profesionales.
parrafo_1.en: Sol y Mar Paellas & Catering sets up the pan, cooks live and builds the full catering table: appetizers, cheese board and dessert, so your event looks and tastes like it was handled by professionals.

parrafo_2.es: El equipo llega con mesas, decoracion y montaje propio: tu solo tienes que recibir a tus invitados.
parrafo_2.en: The team arrives with their own tables, decor and setup: you just have to welcome your guests.

texto.es: Fecha, numero de invitados y si quieres solo paella o catering completo.

texto.es: Te armamos el presupuesto segun el menu y el numero de invitados, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: We put together the quote based on the menu and guest count, no surprises.

texto.es: Llegamos con paellera, mesas y decoracion, y cocinamos en vivo frente a tus invitados.
texto.en: We arrive with the paella pan, tables and decor, and cook live in front of your guests.

texto.es: Servimos a tus invitados y dejamos el area limpia al terminar.

nota.es: El menu se arma segun tu evento y numero de invitados. Escribenos para el presupuesto exacto.

texto.es: Camarones, mejillones, almejas y pollo cocidos en vivo en paellera grande, al momento.
texto.en: Shrimp, mussels, clams and chicken cooked live in a large pan, right on the spot.

texto.es: Tabla fria con quesos, jamon, frutas y galletas, lista antes de que llegue la paella.
texto.en: Cold board with cheeses, cured meats, fruit and crackers, ready before the paella arrives.

texto.es: Chafing dishes, montaje y servicio de mesa para bodas, cumpleanos y fiestas privadas.
texto.en: Chafing dishes, table setup and service for weddings, birthdays and private parties.

texto.es: Cupcakes y postres de cierre con el empaque de marca de la casa.
texto.en: Cupcakes and closing desserts in the house branded packaging.

pie.es: Tambien armamos menus a medida para grupos grandes. Escribenos los detalles.

items.quote: Hired Sol y Mar Paellas for my daughter's 30th birthday for the very first time and I was so amazed by their performance, super friendly and by far one of the BEST paellas I've ever had. Delicious!
I honestly think Sol y Mar is one of the best paella companies you can hire. They were so professional, friendly, and the service was incredible. And the paella was delicious.
Amazing experience from start to finish! The paella was absolutely delicious, fresh, flavorful, and a huge hit with everyone at our gathering.
